message: I’ve always been one to pack a little extra for road trips—snacks, blankets, you name it! 🚗 It’s amazing how a bit of preparation can turn a simple drive into a cozy adventure. If you’re like me and love being gloriously over-prepared, you might want to check out some handy tips for staying safe on the road. After all, it’s the little things that make a big difference, isn’t it?
